== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker) (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100684 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100684], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100684-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>85ae58d37b244094761151627efa72400a2b60bacc79d5d3903efd93202b784b</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
